output_list.reason: The 'reward' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. It allows a contract owner to issue arbitrary large rewards to user accounts, leading to a situation where the totalRewardIssuedOut mapping value can be exploited to reach a balanceOf[_from] value of 2^256, allowing the owner to issue unlimited tokens to any user account.

The 'transferReward' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. It allows a contract owner to issue arbitrary large rewards to user accounts, leading to a situation where the totalRewardIssuedOut[msg.sender]+= _value can be exploited to reach a balanceOf[_from] value of 2^256, allowing the owner to issue unlimited tokens to any user account.
